firestore.reasoning: This design prioritizes security and scalability. The `estimateRequests` collection is added to store form submissions and is restricted to admin access only, ensuring customer data privacy. A `folders` collection is added to persist folder names for the media library. Page and PageElement entities and collections have been removed to simplify the app.
